capture: Apply the patch to a disposable checkout. Run ./gradlew --offline runGameTestServer with CREATE_TRANSMISSION_REOPEN=write, then open the same save in a separate process with CREATE_TRANSMISSION_REOPEN=read. The read phase samples six saved, force-loaded rigs and places no blocks. Four rigs have a running input and two have neither a motor nor a redstone input.
tick_origin: Write tick 7 is the last Java GameTest sample before shutdown. Read ticks 0 through 7 are GameTest samples after the second server opens the saved world and completes its startup.
